slides.b: "Sales up 18% in October", not "Sales by month". People read the title and nothing else.
Pie charts only for two or three slices. Anything more, use bars.
Sort the data largest to smallest before you insert the chart. The order does the explaining.
Click the gridlines and the legend, press Delete. Label the bars directly instead.
Grey for everything, one strong colour for the bar you want them to see.
